question: What will be the compound interest on Rs. 21000 at the rate of 10% per annum for 6 months compounded half - yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

The Sum = Rs. 21000

The rate of interest = 10% per annum

The time = 6 months

**Formula used:**

C.I.={Ptimes [({1+{Rover100}})^T-1]} Where, C.I. = Compound interest, P = Principle, R = Rate, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let the compound interest be X.
